title: Which town's onions cost more over the year?
description: Twelve monthly onion prices in two towns are compared on the board by the highest price, the total, the range and the mean. Keeko doubts that the town with the single highest price must be the costlier one.
teaching_notes: One idea: one number from each town can mislead; the total, the range and the mean describe the whole year. Watch for children who decide by the single highest price. The book has a child say Wahapur has 3 prices in the 50s; each town has 2.

source: Compare the onion prices of Yahapur and Wahapur by the highe
video_script.why: The child can find a mean and a range and now meets a real question with twelve values a side.
video_script.substitution: Both towns have twelve months, so totals and means compare fairly.
video_script.wrong_answer: Wahapur is costlier, because sixty is the highest price of all
video_script.wrong_move: decides for the whole year from one month's peak price
video_script.payoff_line: Yahapur is a little costlier on average

final_answer.value: Yahapur, mean 38.17 against 37.5 rupees per kg
final_answer.spoken: Yahapur is a little costlier on average, with a mean of about thirty eight point one seven against thirty seven point five rupees per kilogram

names.Ziva: compares the onion prices of the two towns

maths_rules: Yahapur total 458, Wahapur total 450 (12 months each)
mean: 458 / 12 = 38.17 (to two places); 450 / 12 = 37.5 rupees per kg
month by month: Yahapur higher in 6, Wahapur in 5, equal in June (not shown: step limit)
video_script.design: One idea: summarise twelve values with more than one number. Two rows of twelve price tags stay on the board and four measures are written under them one at a time.

narration: <bookmark mark='g1'/>Twenty four prices are too many to compare one by one.
<bookmark mark='g2'/>We can sum up each town with a few numbers instead.
<bookmark mark='g3'/>We will use the highest price, the total and the mean.
<bookmark mark='g4'/>One more is the highest price take away the lowest price, and that is called the range.

beats.on_screen: Answer: Yahapur is a little costlier on average: mean ≈ 38.17 against 37.5 rupees per kg
narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Yahapur is a little costlier on average.
Its mean is about thirty eight point one seven, against thirty seven point five for Wahapur.

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks Wahapur is costlier, because sixty is the highest price of all.
Sixty is the price in only one month of the year.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>Wahapur also had the two cheapest months, seventeen and nineteen.
<bookmark mark='idea'/>One high month does not make a town costlier for the year.
